# Fetch all songs from Spotify song library (paginated)
api = apis.spotify
access_token = spotify_token
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
song_ids = set()
song_details = {}  # song_id -> (title, artists_str)

while True:
    resp = api.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    items = resp if isinstance(resp, list) else resp.get('songs') if isinstance(resp, dict) else resp
    if not items:
        break
    print('song library page', page_index, 'items', len(items))
    for it in items:
        sid = it['song_id']
        song_ids.add(sid)
        # Build artists string now
        artists = [a['name'] for a in it.get('artists', [])]
        artists_str = '|'.join(artists)
        if sid not in song_details:
            song_details[sid] = (it.get('title',''), artists_str)
    page_index += 1

print('Total song library unique song_ids:', len(song_ids))
print('Song_details populated:', len(song_details))

# Build CSV manually (avoid csv.writer restrictions)
import re

def csv_escape(field):
    if field is None:
        field = ''
    field = str(field)
    # Escape double quotes by doubling them
    field = field.replace('"','""')
    return f'"{field}"'

rows = []
for sid in union_song_ids:
    title, artists_str = song_details[sid]
    rows.append((title, artists_str))

rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0].lower(), x[1].lower()))

lines = ['"Title","Artists"']
for title, artists_str in rows:
    # artists_str already uses '|' separator; just escape as CSV field
    lines.append(csv_escape(title) + ',' + csv_escape(artists_str))

csv_text = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
print('unique_song_count', len(rows))
print('csv_lines_total_including_header', len(lines))
print('csv_preview_first_3')
print('\n'.join(lines[:4]))
print('csv_preview_last_2')
print('\n'.join(lines[-3:]))

# Ensure directory exists (again)
backup_dir = '~/backups'
print('backup_dir_exists', apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=backup_dir, access_token=fs_token))

file_path = '~/backups/spotify.csv'
print('file_exists_before', apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token))

resp = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token, content=csv_text, overwrite=True)
print('create_file_resp', resp)

# Read back to verify
file_info = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
content_read = file_info.get('content','')
print('read_back_len', len(content_read), 'written_len', len(csv_text))
# Count lines
line_count = len(content_read.splitlines())
print('read_back_line_count', line_count)
# Sample verify first and last lines
read_lines = content_read.splitlines()
print('read_first_2', read_lines[:2])
print('read_last_2', read_lines[-2:])
